programs.title: Tree Climbing Lions
programs.desc: Alexander Braczkowski, a biologist of Polish origin, sets out on a mission to track lions living in Uganda.He has 90 days to observe animal behavior and estimate the size of the local population.The lions in Queen Elizabeth National Park function quite uniquely - they spend most of their lives in trees.During his journey, Braczkowski observes how females raise young.The seemingly easy expedition took on a new dimension when the herd living in the reserve became a human target.Since then, the specialist in big cats has not only immortalized their beauty in films and photographs, but has also been actively involved in their protection.

programs.title: Animal Fight Club
programs.desc: There is a constant struggle in the animal kingdom.Lions, elephants, polar bears and cobras engage in deadly fights.The cameras capture scenes full of tension, drama and determination.Each fight has a story behind it.An alligator boldly wanting to assert its dominance, a hungry bear fighting for food, or a fox taking part in a mating ritual - they will show their capabilities.Unique recordings show the colorful and cruel world of animals.Tactics, hidden weapons, deception - wild creatures use all possibilities and will stop at nothing to survive.

programs.title: The Wild Sides
programs.desc: The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the hauntings of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son.

programs.title: Born In Africa: The Circle of Life
programs.desc: A documentary about small predators that learn to avoid the dangers of the African savannah.We will see the first moments of babies, learn about the protectiveness of their mothers or entire herds, and learn about the complicated realities of parenthood on the savannah.The film shows how different approaches to raising young people can be and how the success or failure of parents in this area affects the world around them.Children have little time to adapt to difficult conditions, and it is the youngest who face the greatest dangers.

programs.title: Wild Mongolia: Compilation
programs.desc: Mongolia is a region characterized by extremes.Over millions of years, animals living in the harsh climate here have learned the art of survival and developed adaptive skills.

programs.title: Animals Gone Wild
programs.desc: The program presents the most extraordinary moments from the lives of animals.Viewers will see both suspenseful and shocking footage.
